title: Sandbox seam: provider-neutral interface + Docker adapter + `osf sandbox run`
summary: Adds a provider-neutral `Sandbox` seam (create/run/destroy/capabilities) with an in-memory `FakeSandbox` double, a Docker adapter that drives one `docker` invocation per operation through a `DockerRunner` (real process runner with capped, timeout-killed output), and a new `osf sandbox run` CLI that plans a spec, validates it before any docker call, prints a dry-run argv JSON, and otherwise creates, runs one command, and always destroys the sandbox while passing the command's exit status through.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/main.rs
lanes.summary: The `osf` binary gains a `sandbox` subcommand whose `run` action parses flags, checks the two folders, and delegates planning and execution.

lanes.label: Host orchestration
lanes.subtitle: sandbox_cli + sandbox seam
lanes.summary: Provider-neutral request/plan/execute logic and the `Sandbox` trait that every provider implements.

lanes.label: Docker adapter
lanes.subtitle: docker_sandbox.rs
lanes.summary: Turns a `SandboxSpec` into `docker` argv, runs one invocation per operation, and parses the tool's output back into results.

lanes.label: Container runtime
lanes.subtitle: docker daemon + container
lanes.summary: The external docker program and the throwaway container it creates, starts, execs into, and removes.

nodes.label: osf main
nodes.subtitle: fn main / sandbox_run_cmd
nodes.summary: Adds the `Sandbox` command and `SandboxRunArgs`, resolves `--repo` and `--state` to absolute existing folders, builds a `RunRequest`, and prints either the dry-run JSON or the execution's streams and exit code.

nodes.label: sandbox_cli
nodes.subtitle: plan / dry_run_json / execute
nodes.summary: Builds the `SandboxSpec` and `CommandSpec` from a `RunRequest`, validates both with the adapter's validators before any docker call, renders the dry-run argv JSON, and executes create → run → destroy over the `Sandbox` seam, mapping outcomes to exit codes 0/2/124/125.

nodes.label: Sandbox trait
nodes.subtitle: create / run / destroy / capabilities
nodes.summary: The provider-neutral interface plus its data types: `SandboxSpec`, `CommandSpec`, `RunResult`, `RunOutcome`, `Destroyed`, `Capability` and `SandboxError`. Destroying an unknown sandbox is `AlreadyGone`, not an error.

nodes.label: FakeSandbox
nodes.subtitle: in-memory double
nodes.summary: Records every call as plain serializable data, answers from scripted run results, and can be told to fail one operation. Used by the CLI and engine-style tests with no process, file, network or clock.

nodes.label: DockerSandbox
nodes.subtitle: impl Sandbox for DockerSandbox<R>
nodes.summary: Validates the spec and command, then drives create (with a 120s timeout), start, exec (with the command's timeout), kill on timeout, and rm --force. Capabilities come from three probes: server version, image inspect, and network plugins.

nodes.label: argv builders
nodes.subtitle: create_argv / exec_argv / …
nodes.summary: Pure functions that pin the exact `docker` argv for create, start, exec, kill, rm, version, image inspect and network probe, plus the validators for spec, user, name, mount and command.

nodes.label: RealDockerRunner
nodes.subtitle: spawn + capped pipes + kill tree
nodes.summary: Spawns the docker program in its own process group, reads both pipes on threads with a 1 MiB per-stream cap, waits with an optional timeout, and kills the whole tree on timeout or error.

nodes.label: docker program
nodes.subtitle: docker CLI
nodes.summary: The installed docker binary the runner spawns; every operation is one invocation.

nodes.label: sandbox container
nodes.subtitle: sleep 2147483647 keep-alive
nodes.summary: The throwaway container created from the pinned image, started with a keep-alive command, exec'd into for the user's command, and removed afterwards.

nodes.label: repo folder
nodes.subtitle: --repo → /workspace
nodes.summary: The host repository folder, bind-mounted read-write at /workspace inside the container.

nodes.label: state folder
nodes.subtitle: --state → /state
nodes.summary: The host state folder, bind-mounted read-write at /state so a run can leave artifacts behind.

flows.title: `osf sandbox run` end to end
flows.summary: One command: the CLI plans and validates, the adapter creates and starts a container, execs the command with its timeout, kills on timeout, and always removes the container, passing the command's exit status back.

messages.label: plan(RunRequest)
messages.note: Builds the spec and command, then validates both; a refusal exits 2 before any docker call.

messages.label: docker create …
messages.note: 120s timeout; the argv pins cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges, the user, workdir, network and mounts.

messages.label: docker start <id>
messages.note: A failed start removes the container and reports the start text.

messages.label: docker exec <id> …
messages.note: The command's timeout is the runner's wait limit; output is capped at 1 MiB per stream.

messages.label: docker kill <id>
messages.note: Only on timeout: the container is killed, then the run reports TimedOut.

messages.label: destroy(id)
messages.note: Always attempted, including after a failed run; a failed removal becomes exit 125.

messages.label: Execution {stdout, stderr, exit_code}
messages.note: Exit code is the command's own, 124 on timeout, 125 on docker failure, 2 on refusal.
